excluded_suite: core (42 historical tasks; no new evaluation scheduled)
model_identity_policy: record requested alias and returned model per response; stop for review if resolution changes from the accepted preflight
core_profile: default binary-item prompt; do not enable fixed-pro-v2
core_metric: weighted PASS sum / total points; task mean with fixed denominator 42
critical_fail: record critical_pass=false, not automatic whole-task zero
advisory_metric: per-task fraction of applicable dimensions at highest native label; task mean with fixed denominator 263
failure_policy: recover scoring if answer exists; terminal failed cells zero, retain failure category
deduplication: first accepted score, never best score
answer_policy: reuse frozen generated answers; preserve final-answer extraction and evidence provenance; no policy reroll for rescoring
generation_harness: ours Docker/OpenCode; upstream formal results direct Chat; scoring alignment alone is not generation alignment
training_reward: current GRPO remains fixed Flash 0731 and equal training-rubric PASS fraction
